name: "Yui" ~Wasurerareta Shoujo~
source:
It's a story of a frail thirty-something protagonist who is tired of life and meets a woman. It happened in a small shrine I visited by a strange coincidence....

A dull, life-weary old man (in his late 30s) and a young girl meet...

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ168748.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
这是一个三十多岁的弱者主角厌倦了生活并遇到了一个女人的故事。这件事发生在我参观的一个小神社里，这是一个奇怪的巧合……

一个迟钝、厌倦生活的老人（三十多岁）和一个年轻女孩相遇了……

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ168748.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite英语[/url]]
